title: Complete discovery pass for all inventoried assets
description: Verify paths, classify unknowns, expand DOC-KG-CLUSTER and DTO trees to file-level where P0/P1
validation_commands: git ls-files; path exists checks; ripgrep consumers
acceptance_criteria: every P0/P1 asset path classified EXISTS or MISSING; no untracked critical clinical/prompt asset
stop_conditions: confirmed real patient data sample found; conflicting A6.5 implementation appears

title: Quarantine PHI-capable and unlicensed medical sources
description: Mark quarantine dispositions; forbid content sampling; open privacy/legal reviews
acceptance_criteria: all PHI-capable and medical-source assets QUARANTINE or explicit exception with owner
stop_conditions: need to read private live patient stores without authorization

title: Extract clinical-policy candidates without approval
acceptance_criteria: candidates listed with source paths; approved counts remain 0; no Capability mutation
stop_conditions: attempt to approve rules into A6

title: Structural parse of clinical/knowledge/prompt files
description: Parse formats; record schema completeness; no clinical correctness claims
validation_commands: python parse harness local-only; yaml/json/csv loads
acceptance_criteria: L1 status recorded per asset; failures quarantined

title: Provenance license privacy governance pass
acceptance_criteria: no UNKNOWN license on P0 medical sources without NEEDS_LEGAL_REVIEW flag
stop_conditions: production use of unlicensed corpus discovered

title: Duplication and conflict detection
description: Detect duplicate prompts/engines/rules and doc-code conflicts
acceptance_criteria: duplicates listed with SoT candidate or CONFLICTING

title: Map Tool/CDP/AgentState/AuditTrail to Shared Contracts
description: Field-level mapping to contracts/v1; record gaps; no runtime wiring
acceptance_criteria: mapping complete for P0 state/tool assets; incompatibilities listed
stop_conditions: runtime service changes requested as part of mapping

title: Map legacy clinical packs to A6 Capability schemas
description: Map rules/terminology/prompts to capability slots without filling approved content
acceptance_criteria: A6 approved_* remain 0; lifecycle remains DRAFT; gaps explicit

title: AOP/Trace and observability migration mapping
description: Specialized validation plan for Trace failure isolation, PHI, Feign/OTel
validation_commands: planned tests only; no production cutover
acceptance_criteria: migration plan+test matrix complete; old path not deleted
stop_conditions: proposal to disable legacy trace without fallback

title: Synthetic regression planning for non-clinical behaviors
description: Plan fixtures for workflow/tool/trace behaviors; forbid PHI and clinical gold labels
acceptance_criteria: synthetic-only policy enforced; missing suites located or declared absent
stop_conditions: real patient cases proposed as fixtures

title: Disposition board for P0/P1 assets
acceptance_criteria: every P0/P1 has disposition+owner+evidence pointer; Coverage Matrix upgradable plan

title: Write-back Migration/Coverage matrices and exit-gate check
description: Update matrices statuses from DESIGNED toward evidence-backed states without claiming production readiness
acceptance_criteria: no valuable unowned asset remains; A7 still not started
